This is the shader from the issue, unmodified. The DXC panes are Linux Release
builds, so the thing to look for is that both terminate abnormally with a
signal instead of producing DXIL -- this is a compiler crash, not a diagnostic
and not a validation error.

The trigger is the pair of local variable declarations near the end of
vert_main whose declared type has empty square brackets, initialised by
assignment from an array member of the static struct. Give those two
declarations an explicit bound and the same shader compiles cleanly.

An assert-enabled build stops earlier, in clang CodeGen, and Compiler Explorer
ships no such DXC, so this link shows only the Release face of the defect.

The third pane is the in-progress HLSL front end in Clang, syntax-only. Ignore
its SV_ClipDistance and SV_CullDistance errors -- those semantics are simply
not implemented there yet and have nothing to do with this. The interesting
lines are the two "array initializer must be an initializer list" errors, which
land on exactly the two declarations that crash DXC.
